## Implementation Notes

### Manual Compaction Command

**Pattern**: Follow existing slash command structure in `src/cli/interactive.ts`:
```typescript
case 'compact': {
  const session = state.sessionManager.getCurrentSession();
  if (!session) {
    console.log(c('yellow', '\n  No active session to compact\n'));
    return true;
  }
  
  // Handle --status flag for inspection
  if (args[0] === '--status' || args[0] === '-s') {
    // Show current compaction state
    const metadata = session.metadata;
    console.log(c('cyan', '\n  Compaction Status:\n'));
    // Display compaction metrics from session metadata
    return true;
  }
  
  // Trigger manual compaction
  console.log(c('gray', '\n  Compacting session history...\n'));
  const result = await state.sessionManager.compact();
  console.log(c('green', `\n  Compacted ${result.originalMessages} messages to ${result.compactedMessages}`));
  console.log(c('gray', `  Estimated tokens saved: ${result.estimatedTokensSaved}\n`));
  return true;
}
```

**Integration with SessionManager**: The `compact()` method already exists at line 1309 of `src/core/sessionManager.ts`. Returns `CompactionResult` with `originalMessages`, `compactedMessages`, `estimatedTokensSaved`, and `summary`.

**Tests**: Add to `src/cli/__tests__/interactive.test.ts` or `tests/compaction.test.ts`:
- Manual compaction with active session succeeds
- Manual compaction with no session shows error
- `--status` flag displays compaction state
- No double-compaction when manual + auto both trigger

### TUI Draft Persistence

**Storage location**: Per-session temp files under `~/.alexi/drafts/<session-id>.txt` OR in-memory session context (prefer session context for simplicity).

**Pattern**: Extend `InputBox.tsx` component:
```typescript
// Store draft on text change
useEffect(() => {
  if (sessionId && value) {
    sessionContext.setDraft(sessionId, value);
  }
}, [value, sessionId]);

// Restore draft on session switch
useEffect(() => {
  const draft = sessionContext.getDraft(sessionId);
  if (draft && sessionId === currentSessionId) {
    setValue(draft);
  }
}, [sessionId]);

// Clear draft on send
const handleSubmit = () => {
  sessionContext.clearDraft(sessionId);
  onSubmit(value);
};
```

**Guard**: Verify session ID match before restoring to prevent cross-session draft pollution.

**Tests**: Add to `src/cli/tui/__tests__/InputBox.test.tsx`:
- Draft persists on session switch
- Draft restores when returning to session
- Draft clears on message send
- Mismatched session ID rejects draft restore

### Content-Filter Finish Reason

**Current behavior**: Issue #1903 describes that content-filter responses trigger retries, wasting tokens and confusing users.

**Fix location**: `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` (line ~436 shows compaction call), `src/core/orchestrator.ts`

**Pattern**:
```typescript
// After receiving response from provider
if (response.finishReason === 'content_filter') {
  // Surface to user, do NOT retry
  const message = 'Response blocked by content filter. Please rephrase your request.';
  console.error(c('red', message));
  
  // Emit telemetry
  bus.emit(new ContentFilterTriggered({ sessionId, modelId, timestamp }));
  
  // Return without retry
  return { success: false, reason: 'content_filter' };
}
```

**Tests**: Add to `src/core/__tests__/streamingOrchestrator.test.ts`:
- Content-filter finish reason does not retry
- User receives clear error message
- Telemetry event emitted
